mapper.sql: SELECT i.id AS intentId, o.id AS orderId, i.customer_id AS customerId, COALESCE(o.settlement_customer_id, recharge.settlement_customer_id) AS settlementCustomerId, COALESCE(o.settlement_customer_name_snapshot, recharge.settlement_customer_name_snapshot) AS settlementCustomerName, i.method, i.provider, i.source_type AS sourceType, i.status AS intentStatus, i.amount, t.id AS transactionId, t.status AS transactionStatus, t.provider AS transactionProvider, t.updated_by AS operator, t.provider_amount AS providerAmount, t.paid_at AS paidAt, t.amount AS transactionAmount, r.id AS receiptId, r.customer_id AS receiptCustomerId, r.settlement_customer_id AS receiptSettlementCustomerId, r.amount AS receiptAmount, m.occurred_at AS movementOccurredAt, m.id AS movementId, m.customer_id AS movementCustomerId, m.settlement_customer_id AS movementSettlementCustomerId, m.source_id AS movementIntentId, m.type AS movementType, m.direction AS movementDirection, m.source_type AS movementSourceType, m.amount AS movementAmount FROM payment_intent i LEFT JOIN sales_order o ON i.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND o.id = i.source_id AND o.customer_id = i.customer_id AND o.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN customer_balance_recharge recharge ON i.source_type = 'BALANCE_RECHARGE' AND recharge.id = i.source_id AND recharge.customer_id = i.customer_id AND recharge.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN payment_transaction t ON t.intent_id = i.id AND t.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_receipt r ON r.source_type = 'PAYMENT_TRANSACTION' AND r.source_id = t.id AND r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND r.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN customer_balance_movement m ON m.source_type = 'PAYMENT_INTENT' AND m.source_id = i.id AND m.deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: WHERE i.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND i.source_id = #{orderId} AND i.deleted = FALSE AND i.status = 'SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY i.id, t.id
SELECT * FROM customer_balance_movement WHERE id = #{movementId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_receipt r JOIN payment_transaction t ON r.source_type = 'PAYMENT_TRANSACTION' AND t.id = r.source_id JOIN payment_intent i ON i.id = t.intent_id WHERE r.id = #{receiptId} AND i.source_type = 'BALANCE_RECHARGE')

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_write_off w JOIN finance_receivable ar ON w.target_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND w.target_id = ar.id WHERE ar.order_id = #{orderId} AND ar.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND ar.deleted = FALSE AND w.source_type = 'RECEIPT' AND w.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND w.deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_write_off reverse WHERE reverse.reverse_of_id = w.id AND reverse.entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND reverse.deleted = FALSE))
